Team,

Numbers check: current forecasted ACV if HelioTech converts post-launch = ~$420k. If they sign a 12-month minimum post-launch commit, revenue profile improves materially and payback is within 4 quarters.

Finance view: we can support a rebate program as credits, but recommend limiting to 15% tied to milestone validation and conditional on:
- 12-month ARR commit (contract clause),
- Net-30 payment terms post-credit issuance OR confirmation that credits will reduce future invoices (not retro refunds),
- A short clawback clause if they terminate within 6 months of launch.

If Sales wants to push to 20%, we need CFO sign-off due to margin impact and to document an exec exception with justification (strategic account / reference value).

I'll prepare a one-page financial memo and draft the contractual language for the credit schedule. Neha, pls advise whether CFO sign-off is doable for 20% or whether 15% is your ceiling.

Team,

Reviewed. My decision: approve a 15% milestone-linked rebate issued as invoice credits under the following conditions:
1) Customer signs a 12-month minimum post-launch ARR commitment (contract to include explicit language),
2) Credits applied to future invoices only (no cash refunds),
3) Payment terms remain Net-30 after credits; Finance to validate cash flow impact,
4) Clawback if customer cancels within 6 months (pro-rated repayment via future invoices),
5) Legal to review SOW and credit language; Sales to include acceptance criteria for each MAP milestone.

If Sales can present a business case (strategic reference, logo value, or larger multi-year commit) that justifies an additional 5% (i.e., 20% total), I will consider an exception and loop Vivek for final exec sign-off. For now, 15% is approved.
